full_sentence: The shop was closed because the owner was ill that day.

options.text: it opened early in the morning.
options.why_wrong: An early opening would not explain why the shop was closed, so the cause clause does not fit the stem.
Sunshine does not explain why a shop would be closed; 'because' needs a real cause for the closure.
This describes a visit to the shop, which contradicts the idea that it was closed.

options.text: the owner was ill that day.

explanation: After 'because', the clause must give the reason for the first part of the sentence. Learners sometimes choose a clause that describes the situation instead of its cause, so check that the clause explains the closure.
